description: This file contains the implementation of an autoloader class for the Smarty templating engine, which manages loading Smarty classes and plugins dynamically.

classes.name: Smarty_Autoloader
classes.description: A class that provides static methods for registering and handling autoloading of Smarty classes and plugins.

methods.name: registerBC
methods.description: Registers the autoloader in a backward-compatible way, optionally prepending it.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the autoloader, setting up the directory paths and registering the autoload method.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Handles the dynamic loading of Smarty classes and plugins based on class name.
